Bug_Title: UwF: Field only ever set to null (UWF_NULL_FIELD)
Bug_Details:
All writes to this field are of the constant value null, and thus
all reads of the field will return null.
Check for errors, or remove it if it is useless.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by declaring a field 'nullableField' and setting it to null in both its declaration and constructor. This ensures that any read operation on 'nullableField' will always return null.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method of the NullFieldExample class, which returns the nullableField. Since nullableField is always set to null, the assertNotNull assertion fails, triggering the bug.
